description: This file contains a data migration class for the OrchardCore CMS, specifically handling HTML content parts. It includes methods for creating and updating content type definitions, migrating content data, and adjusting settings for HTML parts.

classes.name: Migrations
classes.description: A class responsible for managing database schema and content data migrations related to HTML content parts in OrchardCore.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the HTML body part definition with a description and marks the migration as complete with version 5.

methods.name: UpdateFrom1
methods.description: Placeholder method for migration step from version 1 to 2.

methods.name: UpdateFrom2
methods.description: Placeholder method for migration step from version 2 to 3.

methods.name: UpdateFrom3Async
methods.description: Performs content type updates, migrates content item versions by transforming 'BodyPart' content to 'HtmlBodyPart', and removes the old 'BodyPart' definition.

methods.name: UpdateFrom4Async
methods.description: Adjusts HTML part settings for backward compatibility by disabling HTML sanitization.
